answer: Agents bond stake to a Semaphore membership and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations support RLN proofs and rate limits. A valid message proves membership without disclosing identity; duplicate messaging in the same epoch yields conflicting evaluations that, under Shamir secret sharing, reconstruct the agent’s private key. The verifier can then link the violation to the bond and trigger immediate collateral slashing, whether the attack arrives like an onyx tide or a gale.
